description_zh: 行业模板四件套：连接器 pack（Shopify 复用已采纳件 + 国内平台只读实测面）+ 对账舰队蓝图（巡检/核对/拍板，复用三舰观测面）+ 科目映射 pack（呈现层对齐内核通用科目）+ 报表 preset（店铺对账日报/费用/映射看板）。三方对账、多币种出处汇率、平台费用独立维度；平台侧零写入；真实店读写暂缓待商家自带凭证。 能力矩阵（capability-matrix.json）随连接器 pack 分发：报表腿与对账腿数由矩阵派生，不可得腿显式标注。
description_en: Four-piece vertical template: connector pack (Shopify adopted + CN platforms read-only measured surface) + recon fleet blueprint (watch/reconcile/approve reusing the three watch fleets) + account mapping pack (presentation layer over kernel universal accounts) + report preset. Three-way recon, sourced FX, independent fee dimensions; zero platform writes; real-store writes deferred pending merchant credentials.

pack_v2.note: 连接器/映射 pack 均为 pack v2 形状（skills/mcpServers/fleet/_casting 齐备，fleet 段免自指指向在册 fleet-board-contribution）；谦面市场安装模板 = 四件一并到位、各件独立升级。

en.name: Cross-border E-commerce Reconciliation Template
en.description: Four-piece vertical template: connectors + recon fleet + account mapping + report preset.
